title: Validation of artificial intelligence algorithms for the diagnosis of X-ray images in paediatric diagnostics
summary:
This is a retrospective data analysis that takes place at one location. 
In this project, artificial intelligence algorithms are being tested to analyse X-ray images. This is being done specifically for children and young people aged 0 to 18 to see how well the algorithms work in this area.
conditions: Presence of x-ray in pediatric/child surgical context

interventions.name:
- Identification of specific patient cohorts and suitable control cohorts and/or clinically representative cohorts in a circumscribed retrospective period 
- Export and anonymisation of the underlying image data 
- Analysis of the exported image data using the AI algorithms used and determination

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. paediatric patient collective, i.e. all patients who are cared for by a paediatric or paediatric surgery/orthopaedic department of the LMU Clinic, usually age <= 18 years with exceptions (e.g. adult patients who are cared for by the CF outpatient clinic)
2. availability of X-ray images
3. the usual quality criteria of X-ray technology apply (e.g. pathology shown, image analysable)
Exclusion criteria:
1. non-paediatric population (as described above).
